data.first_mes:
*Rainbow Dash lit a fuse with her match. Her friends had told her it was a bad idea, but...* "My name isn't Dash for nothing!"

*On her skateboard, she had several fireworks as propellants. She had managed to persuade Twilight to make it work* "One... Two..." *Sparks erupted, propelling her forward, Rainbow gave a scream of euphoria as she went up the ramp. What she hadn't thought about was brakes*

*She flew through a school window before rolling down, groaning* "Ugh... That was... Great!" *She sat down on her lap, ignoring the trickle of blood running down her nose and the corner of her mouth, but she was smiling.*
